text:
Maya R: Heads up — I’m seeing a sustained invoice delivery latency spike starting ~06:10 UTC. Preview invoices are delayed and some customers’ previews show missing watermark queries. Dashboard shows ingest watermark lag ~2.5–3h.
Sam P: ugh, saw alerts. Is this the priority-ingest path or the finalizer?
Maya R: Looks like priority-ingest. The finalizer has events but the priority TTL window seems to be dropping earlier. Suspect retention/window calc mismatch between router and aggregator.
Anika K: can you paste the query that’s used to compute watermarks in the preview service? I want to compare with aggregator logic.
Maya R: sure — from preview service:```sql
SELECT tenant_id, max(event_ts) as last_seen
FROM meter_events
WHERE route_priority = 'priority'
  AND event_ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id;```
Maya R: aggregator uses `route_priority` + `ingest_ttl_seconds` param, but I noticed the priority TTL for one shard was set to 90000 (25h) not 172800 (48h) after last config rollout.
Liam T: that would explain. Which config rollout touched the shard? Could be the canary that changed default TTL.
Sam P: I grep’d the canary logs — deploy 2026-03-08 updated `default_ingest_policies` and we forgot to propagate `priority_ttl_seconds` override to the route-resolver in some regions.
Nadia O: I’m oncall, running a quick check: console shows region-us-east-2 route-resolver version mismatch on two replica nodes. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/ops/routes/route-resolver-status
ingest-bot: automated note — shard 7 last config sync: 2026-03-09T02:11:04Z, version: v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4 (partial).
Anika K: so some shards had old TTL and caused early eviction from priority cache -> later events looked like late-arrivals and didn’t count toward preview watermark -> invoice preview shows missing tokens.
Maya R: right. Impact: preview invoices for ~120 tenants in us-east-2; production invoices (finalizer) are correct because finalizer uses full 7-day window.
Sam P: mitigation idea: temporarily extend the priority replication window in aggregator so late events within 4h get re-associated; then backfill watermarks for affected tenants. Thoughts?
Liam T: pragmatic. We should also push a hotfix to the route-resolver config sync to force full propagation. I can prepare a manifest for immediate rollout.
Nadia O: I'll approve hotfix churn as urgent. Sam, can you run a quick dry-run of backfill script on staging?
Sam P: yes. Running local backfill with `--max-window=14400` (4h) on staging now. Logs look ok.
Sam P: sample backfill command:```bash
python scripts/backfill_watermarks.py --env staging --window 14400 --tenants-file affected_tenants.txt
```
Anika K: will backfill affect billing totals? We need to avoid double-counting tokens when final invoices are generated.
Maya R: plan: mark backfilled watermarks as `preview_backfill=true` tag in preview table; final invoice pipeline will ignore preview tag and only use finalizer canonical watermarks. Backfill only for previews.
billing-bot: note — if preview backfills are applied, ensure preview-to-final reconciliation job has a de-duplication check on `preview_backfill` tag to avoid adjustments.
Liam T: timeline: hotfix deploy in 10m, tracer to monitor config sync, staging backfill validated in 20m, small preview backfill to prod after verification.
Nadia O: assigning follow-ups: @Liam push hotfix, @Sam run prod dry-run, @Anika validate console preview UX flags, @Maya coordinate customer comms for affected tenants.
Maya R: thanks — I’ll draft a short internal blurb for CS and a quick dashboard widget to surface backfill state.
Sam P: after hotfix I’ll run a lightweight audit query to list tenants with watermark shift > 1h:```sql
SELECT tenant_id, prev_watermark, new_watermark, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (new_watermark - prev_watermark))/3600 as hours_shift
FROM preview_watermarks
WHERE new_watermark IS NOT NULL AND hours_shift > 1;```
Anika K: can console team add a temporary tile showing "priority config drift" with per-shard TTL value? Will help ops triage.
Maya R: good ask. I’ll post a quick tile spec in #eng-observability after this thread.
Liam T: implementing manifest now. ETA 8m.
Nadia O: will keep the incident channel open if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
Maya R: thanks everyone — major risk mitigated if hotfix propagates. I’ll follow up with remediation notes and affected tenant list.
